scope: Read-only post-hoc semantic and coverage clarification of the saved pilot; no extraction rerun, model fit, simulation, or FCD rescan

future_fix.change: Treat vaporized=end as observation cutoff; retain previously completed source activity legs if any, retain unfinished bus exclusion, still reject other nonempty vaporized reasons

methods: Read saved complete.json and compressed leg metadata; recompute saved artifact SHA256 and aggregate accepted count, distinct parent identity, source status, edge equality, endpoint delay, and rejection counters. No FCD parsing.

Parse only the small enhanced tripinfo.xml and stops.xml. Count literal vaporized values crossed with arrival<0. Restrict end-marked vehicles to original-test-excluded and saved taxonomy-supported parents to reproduce the 714-parent exclusion.
Associate stopinfo with those end-marked parent IDs internally. Count started/ended activity parking events and bus stops, then emit aggregates only. No raw IDs retained in this file.
Future code is verified only on synthetic fixtures in a separate server directory. The saved real extraction and its original script hash remain unchanged.

saved_vehicle_vaporized_counter_clarific.interpretation: The saved counter means simulation-cutoff unfinished parents, not 714 destroyed or anomalous vehicles. No completed ordinary activity preleg was identified as lost by this conservative rule in this pilot; unfinished bus services remain ineligible.

accepted_unit_counts.caveat: Distinct parent IDs are not a claim of statistical independence within one shared simulation and repeated demand templates.

source_plan_coverage.caveat: The 49 OD-only flows are not demonstrated repeated-edge ambiguity. Edge-sequence disagreement does not by itself identify rerouting. Flow eligibility was confirmed against emitted routes/endpoints and is target-dependent.

observed_event_endpoint_alignment.caveat: Observed txy span differs from event duration for 1123 legs; reconstruction uses observed span.

limitations: This is a single-pilot event/coverage interface audit, not a training cohort or generation evaluation.
Planned lane-connectivity checks and target-path oracle reconstruction do not jointly prove planned-map trajectory decoding.
Saved real results were produced by the executed script hash above, not the later semantic fix.
